0022600221.text: The Nuggets (5-3, on a two-game win streak) sit 9th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back, and they are on the road against the Grizzlies (7-3), who are 5th in the West, 1 game back in the Southwest, and 5-0 at home. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Nuggets won the season series 3-1, including a 136-119 win in Denver on April 8. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, while Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart and Quinten Post are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions.
